name: MonarchAiPromptToolbar
title: AiPromptToolbar
wrapsNative: androidx.compose.foundation.layout.FlowRow; MonarchButton (androidx.compose.material3.Button) for MonarchAiPromptToolbarButton; androidx.compose.material3.FilterChip for MonarchAiPromptToolbarToggle
summary: The row of compact controls under a prompt (attach, web search, mode, model, tone), with a compact ghost button and an on/off toggle for consistent sizing.
whenToUse: Under or beside an AI prompt field, for options that change how the next prompt is sent.
whenNotToUse: For the actions of a form use MonarchFormActionsBar. For a choice of one tone use MonarchAiTonePicker inside the toolbar rather than several toggles.
api: @Composable fun MonarchAiPromptToolbar(modifier: Modifier = Modifier, label: String? = null, content: @Composable FlowRowScope.() -> Unit)

@Composable fun MonarchAiPromptToolbarButton(text: String, onClick: () -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, enabled: Boolean = true, hideLabel: Boolean = false, icon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, interactionSource: MutableInteractionSource? = null)

@Composable fun MonarchAiPromptToolbarToggle(text: String, checked: Boolean, onCheckedChange: (Boolean) -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, enabled: Boolean = true, hideLabel: Boolean = false, icon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, interactionSource: MutableInteractionSource? = null)

options.name: modifier
options.description: The modifier of the toolbar, button or toggle.

options.name: label
options.description: MonarchAiPromptToolbar: replaces the TalkBack name of the group, "Prompt options" (monarch_aiprompttoolbar_label).

options.name: content
options.description: MonarchAiPromptToolbar: the controls in order. Controls that do not fit move to a new line.

options.name: text
options.description: Button and toggle: the label, and always the TalkBack name.

options.name: onClick
options.description: Button: called when activated. Not called when not enabled.

options.name: checked
options.description: Toggle: whether the option is on.

options.name: onCheckedChange
options.description: Toggle: called with the new state. Not called when not enabled.

options.name: enabled
options.description: Button and toggle: whether the control takes input.

options.name: hideLabel
options.description: Button and toggle: shows only the icon; the text stays the TalkBack name. Ignored without an icon.

options.name: icon
options.description: Button and toggle: an icon before the label, for example a MonarchIcon with a null content description. Monarch bundles no icons.

options.name: interactionSource
options.description: Button and toggle: the source of the press, focus and hover interactions.

states.name: toggle on
states.description: The assistant subtle fill, the assistant border and strong assistant text.

states.name: toggle off
states.description: A ghost control in muted text with no border.

states.name: disabled
states.description: Button and toggle use the disabled text role; a toggle that is on keeps the muted fill and the subtle border, so its state stays visible.

states.name: wrapped
states.description: Controls that do not fit move to a new line.

appearance: The button is the ghost MonarchButton at the small size. The toggle is transparent with muted text when off, and the assistant subtle fill, assistant border and strong assistant text when on. Both use the control radius. The same roles apply in light, dark and both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: The web ships AiPromptToolbarButton and AiPromptToolbarToggle and Android ships the same two, because Compose cannot restyle arbitrary buttons through the environment as iOS does. The toggle is a Material 3 FilterChip, the Material 3 toggle with a text label (as the toggle-button entry documents), so TalkBack reads it as selected or not selected instead of the web's pressed state. The toggle is 36dp high inside a 48dp touch target. The web's uncontrolled defaultPressed is not offered: state is hoisted. The check mark iOS adds for Differentiate Without Color has no Android setting; the on state always has a border.
accessibility: The toolbar is a TalkBack traversal group named "Prompt options" or the label given; each control inside is its own element, read in order.
The button keeps the Material 3 button role; an icon-only button is named by its text.
The toggle keeps the FilterChip role and selected state; its label does not change with its state.
An icon-only toggle is named by its text.
Every control has a touch target of at least 48dp by 48dp.
A toggle that is on also differs by its border, so the state does not depend on color alone.
edgeCases: Controls wider than the row get a line of their own and their text wraps.
An empty toolbar takes no height.
hideLabel without an icon shows the label, because the control would be empty.
